consumer: The crafting eligibility check for a craft-here salvage objective, asking whether at least 20 scrap is available across the crafting-reachable inventory (avatar plus nearby reachable items).
scope: The full crafting-reachable inventory within reach (avatar carried/wielded PLUS nearby map/vehicle items the crafting search counts), not just on-person.
decisive_source: src/visitable.cpp::visitable<Character>::amount_of — special-cases bionic pseudo-tools then defers to amount_of_internal, tallying ONLY what the Character carries/wields, i.e. on-person scope.
divergence: Avatar holds 5 scrap but 30 more scrap sits in an adjacent tile/vehicle within crafting reach: the proposed Character.amount_of returns 5 and reports the objective unmet, while the craft-here check counting everything within reach should see 35 and pass.
